name: uchiro-store-v3
description: Uchiro Store - Premium Telegram Gaming Mini App, Store Bot, Admin Bot, and API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client-admin && npm install --prefix client-store && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:store && npm run build:server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,STORE,ADMIN,BOTS" -c "cyan,green,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:store" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:bots"
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=server typecheck && npm run --workspace=client-store typecheck && npm run --workspace=client-admin typecheck
